mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, category, author, created_at, updated_at FROM posts ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (title, content, category, author) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{category}, #{author})
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, category = #{category}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE id = #{id}
